source_vs_technical_normalization.source: Source caption labels, level coordinates and clearly depicted relations are recorded as evidence within stated scope.

technical_normalization.closed_prefix_availability: An image-illustrated confirmation can only be consumed when its relevant closed candle and all causal parents are available; annotation availability is separate from depicted historical event time.
